verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party analytics or reporting feature that shows call volume, answer rate, or missed calls broken down per number and per teammate. What is documented is raw data access: the MCP connector can retrieve call history and missed-call info, and the API has a list-calls endpoint. These are developer building blocks a user could aggregate into metrics, not the reporting capability itself.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate

citations.quote: Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number. Use filters to focus on what’s relevant.
